proposal.hypothesis: The pricing for each input is independent and has a fixed-size 64-node initialization and rollback, so a static outer-loop partition should reduce the dominant large-call work without synchronization between elements. The dispatch limits workers to the supplied thread budget and requires at least 256 elements per worker, keeping small calls on a direct serial path and avoiding hardcoding the environment's thread count. Candidate performance remains unmeasured.

retained: Extracted the per-element binomial pricing computation into a helper with private stack-local intermediate values.
Added a serial dispatch path unless more than one worker can receive at least 256 elements.
Parallelized the independent outer loop with static scheduling and num_threads(worker_count), where worker_count is bounded by both the supplied budget and available work.
